title: Product
description: One product, keyed by barcode. One per file, at products/<first 3 digits>/<barcode>.yaml. Where it was made and by whom varies by market, so those facts live only in markets.

barcode.description: EAN-8, UPC-12, EAN-13 or GTIN-14 as printed, quoted. Also the filename.

name.description: Product name as printed, with size. Required in practice: nothing else records it.

notes.description: Optional, 1-2 sentences. Only for a fact that stops the next editor making a wrong change the validator cannot catch.

markets.description: One record per country the product was bought in.

example.description: true if this file is a template rather than curated data.

market.description: Country the product was bought in.

made_in.description: Country of manufacture as the label states it. Never inferred from the barcode.

operator.description: The entity that made the product for this market.

placed_on_market_by.description: The importer, distributor or own-brand retailer the label names for this market. Not the manufacturer.

sources.description: A label photo or official company statement. Transcribed label text starts with 'label text:'.

verified_on.description: ISO 8601 date on which a person last checked this record against its sources.
